text:
**Best pick for a slim iPhone 17 setup: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo)**

It's the best balance of thinness and charging speed. It's 0.34 inches thick and weighs 4.3 oz (122 g), and it charges wirelessly at up to 15W with Qi2 ([Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)). It's $54.99 at Anker's US store, and 9to5Mac says it's also sold on Amazon at that price ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)). Anker's listing includes iPhone 17 in its charging list but also says "iPhone models 12 through 16," so confirm compatibility before buying.

**Other slim options**

| Power bank | Capacity | Thickness / weight | Wireless | Price (per sources) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Baseus PicoGo Air AM71 | 5,000 mAh | ~0.27 in / 104 g | 7.5W | $52.99 on Amazon ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)) |
| LISEN P601 | 5,000 mAh | 0.38 in / 106 g | 15W Qi2 | Wholesale-focused site, so no consumer price listed ([LISEN](https://lisenintl.com/products/p601-magsafe-power-bank/)) |
| INIU SnapGo Air | 10,000 mAh | ~0.5 in / 195 g | 25W Qi2.2 | $42.99 on Amazon ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)) |

- **Thinnest and lightest:** The Baseus PicoGo Air AM71 is the slimmest, but its 7.5W wireless speed is slow. Android Central called it "the lightest, most unbelievably thin power bank" it has used ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **Fastest for iPhone 17:** iPhone 16 and later support 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, which 10K banks like the INIU SnapGo Air support. Those banks are thicker and heavier. iPhone Air tops out at 20W, so it won't reach 25W ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).
- **Best value 25W 10K:** The Baseus PicoGo AM52 is listed at $59.99 (list $79.99). Dealectric says code AM52 takes $6 off, for $53.99, though the store's checkout has the final word. It's 25W wireless on iPhone 16 to 17 running iOS 26, 15W on iPhone 12 to 15, and includes 45W USB-C output ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)). This is an affiliate link, and Dealectric earns a commission on purchases through it.

**My recommendation:** Get the **Anker Nano 5K** if you want a card-thin bank for everyday top-ups. Get the **Baseus PicoGo AM52** (with code AM52) if you want 25W charging and can accept a bit more thickness.

Prices change often, so check the store before buying.
